title_sq: Shitet Njesi tek Piazza ne Qender
description_sq:
Shitet Njesi me siperfaqe totale 24.5 m2 prane Qendres se Tiranes tek zona e njohur si Piazza.
Njesia ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje objekti te ndertuar para viteve 90-te,dhe ka siperfaqe te regjistruar 20 m2 dhe disponon Certifikate Pronesie.
Kjo njesi eshte e pershtatshme per zyre,dyqan dhe cdo lloj aktiviteti tjeter.
Distanca me Sheshin Skenderbej,dhe me te gjitha rruget qendore te Tiranes i jep prones nje vlere te madhe.
Njesia eshte shume e pershtatshme per investim.
Shitet me cmimin 8.500.000 leke.
title_en: Unit for sale in Piazza in the Center
description_en: Unit for sale with a total area of ​​24.5 m2 near the Center of Tirana in the area known as Piazza. The unit is located on the 0th floor of a building built before the 90s, and has a registered area of ​​20 m2 and has a Certificate of Ownership. This unit is suitable for office, shop and any other type of activity. The distance to Skanderbej Square and all the central roads of Tirana gives the property a great value. The unit is very suitable for investment. It is sold at the price of 8,500,000 Lek.
